system.description: You become a primal beast ruled by fury and instinct until you use a one-hour or longer recovery. You cannot activate this ability if you are not in moonlight (at least a half moon). In beast form, you add 8 points to your Might Pool and 2 points to your Speed Pool, and add +2 to your Might Edge and Speed Edge. As a GM intrusion, you might enter a rage, attacking every living creature within short range. The rage lasts until you revert to your normal form. Intentionally reverting to your normal form is a difficulty 2 Intellect task. Once back in your normal form, you are hindered until you use a one-hour or longer recovery. Furthermore, if you did not kill and eat at least one substantial creature while in beast form, your tasks are hindered until you use a ten-hour recovery. Effort: Activate this ability even if you are not in moonlight. Action to change; action to revert.
